layout_summary: A centered two-line meme-style headline sits in the upper third of a pale cream canvas above a large cutout composite of a tabby cat wearing red sunglasses and holding two perfume bottles. The cat subject anchors the bottom center and bleeds off the lower edge.

alignment_axes: Headline, subhead, and central cat subject share a vertical center axis at x=50%
Headline left and right edges sit symmetrically at x=9.5% and x=90.5%
whitespace: 18% empty top margin above the headline
2% vertical gap between headline and subhead
6.5% vertical gap between subhead baseline and top of cat's ears
20% open margins on left and right flanking the subject

scene.subject: Brown tabby cat facing forward wearing glossy red cat-eye sunglasses and a small red satin ribbon bow on its left ear, holding two rectangular glass perfume bottles with black cylindrical caps (pink-red liquid on left, deep blue-amber liquid on right) in its front paws.
scene.composition: Centered vertically in the lower two-thirds, cropped at the chest along the bottom canvas edge, occupying ~59% of canvas width.
scene.camera: Eye-level straight-on medium close-up, sharp focus across fur, sunglasses, and bottle surfaces.
scene.lighting: Soft, even front-lit studio illumination with subtle specular highlights on the red frames and glass bottles.

why_it_works: Generous cream negative space around the upper text ensures immediate readability before the eye drops to the visual punchline.
Strict central symmetry ties the two-line setup directly to the cat's gaze and symmetrical twin perfume bottles.
High-contrast red eyewear and bow draw attention to the cat's face, guiding the viewer down to the held products.
